name: Winkle
summary: Spanish filament manufacturer founded in 2019 in Salamanca by Jorge Garcia, marketing on domestic production ('fabricado en Espana'). The PLA range is segmented by application - HD, Seda (silk), PRO, HS, Texture and recycled grades - alongside PETG including flame-retardant and carbon-filled variants, ASA, ABS and polypropylene.

product_lines.name: PLA HD / Seda / PRO / HS / Texture / Recycled
product_lines.notes: The PLA family: HD and PRO are base-chemistry quality tiers, Seda is the silk/luster grade, HS the high-speed grade, Texture the mineral/stone-effect grade, and Recycled uses recovered feedstock on the same chemistry.

product_lines.name: PETG (incl. FR and CF)
product_lines.notes: Standard and carbon-filled PETG; the flame-retardant grade has no catalog id (abs-fr has no PETG equivalent) and is covered by the base petg mapping.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 19-22/kg. Winkle publishes a factory page describing its own Salamanca extrusion, which is the basis for recording Spain as a manufacturing country. Amazon storefront (the manufacturer schema's endpoints object has no amazon field, so it is recorded here): https://www.amazon.es/stores/WINKLE/page/0B3016B9-4CD8-4CDC-877F-2ABCE1FD7911

provenance.conflicts: Domestic manufacture rests on the company's own factory page; no third-party confirmation or plant audit was found. Whether every line (notably PP and the CF grades) is extruded in Spain or partly bought in is unclear.
